brief:
Residents of Khillet al-Farra and neighboring communities across Masafer Yatta face a deepening crisis as escalating settler attacks combine with the absence of basic services to destabilize their livelihoods, the Palestine News Network reported. The conditions in the South Hebron Hills area have grown increasingly precarious as mounting pressure on residents compounds the hardships they endure.

A new episode of PNN's investigative program "Al-Makshouf" documented the deteriorating circumstances in the region, focusing on how the dual pressures of infrastructure collapse and settler violence are eroding residents' ability to sustain themselves economically and maintain stable community life.

title: Settler attacks and service collapse threaten Masafer Yatta livelihoods
